premise: Every Core learner product must be usable without a teacher physically present.

CORE1.question: What is true?
CORE1.product: Basic notes; topic may be supplied or derived from frozen questions.

CORE1A.question: Teach me this subtopic completely.
CORE1A.product: Detailed subtopic-wise notes with solution-level breakdown, visual clues, diagrams and worked reasoning.

CORE1B.question: Can I reconstruct, explain, represent and independently use what was taught?
CORE1B.product: Open-ended subtopic-wise self-teaching episodes with concept-level guidance.
CORE1B.anti_pattern: Do not turn the publication into a chatbot transcript or minimally guided discovery.

CORE2.question: What is being tested?
CORE2.product: Frozen source questions with governed ladder hints.
CORE2.immutability: Source question identity/body stays frozen except governed source-integrity correction.

CORE2A.question: Show me how an expert recognizes and solves this problem family.
CORE2A.product: Difficulty-adjusted question learning with solution-level breakdown, visuals and worked resolution.
CORE2A.source_rule: Frozen Core2 source items are never rewritten to make them easier; adaptation changes support, ordering, completion level and clearly-labelled generated-original variants.

CORE2B.question: Can I recognize, select and transfer it when the surface changes?
CORE2B.product: Attempt-first open-ended transfer questions with concept-level guidance and full post-attempt resolution.
CORE2B.anti_pattern: Do not reteach the entire concept before the transfer attempt.

hint_ladder.H1_NOTICE: Point attention to the physical event, invariant, relationship or clue; do not give the formula.
hint_ladder.H2_REPRESENT: Prompt the useful representation: diagram, graph, table, event line, component split or symbolic structure.
hint_ladder.H3_START: Give the first executable conceptual/mathematical move, but not the completed solution.
hint_ladder.FULL_SOLUTION: Available only after an attempt path; exposure does not count as independent mastery.

difficulty_pathways.invariant: Difficulty adaptation changes support density, reveal order and selection, not Physics truth or frozen Core2 source wording.
